svg.title: billtruong003: character
svg.desc: Role: Unity Engineer · Games, XR & Tools. Focus: Gameplay, multiplayer, VR, shaders. Base: Vietnam · remote or onsite. Class: Holy Knight · Light. Awakened: 2022-09-26. Shipped Applaydu (50M+ downloads) at Gameloft and Shmackle VR on Meta Quest. Top 6 at Vietnam GameVerse 2024. Also builds web apps, automation and AI agents.
